annotations.title: Set a project's MCP file path

description: Point the project at the repository file that declares its MCP servers, e.g. .cursor/mcp.json or .vscode/mcp.json. null restores the default (.mcp.json). The file is read, never edited. When the repository's ship.yml sets mcp.config, that wins and this call is refused (409); list_mcp_servers reports which one applies as configPathSource. Requires the config:write capability.
name: set_mcp_config_path
title: Set a project's MCP file path
